summary: Tennis tournament Tennis tournament 2022 Axion Open Date 18–24 April 2022 Edition 10th Category ITF Women's World Tennis Tour Prize money $60,000 Surface Clay / Outdoor Location Chiasso , Switzerland Champions Singles Lucia Bronzetti Doubles Anastasia Dețiuc / Miriam Kolodziejová ← 2019 · Chiasso Open · 2023 → The 2022 Axion Open was a professional tennis tournament played on outdoor clay courts . It was the tenth edition of the tournament which was part of the 2022 ITF Women's World Tennis Tour . It took place in Chiasso , Switzerland between 18 and 24 April 2022.
